title: Dual-portfolio formula-interaction transfer and shared-account spillover causality
user_boundary: After the repository integrity patch, resume the existing autonomous Optimization research. New formula hypotheses discovered by Optimization belong in Lab; no Live replacement or deployment authority was granted.

research_height.transfer_path: Two exact formula interactions are tested across both fixed portfolio contracts and formula-unseen later intervals, then decomposed into changed-component and unchanged-component economics before any seed can return to Optimization.

central_question: Do either of the two exact post-selection formula interactions transfer beyond E1-E3 as direct changed-component economics, or were their apparent improvements selection-local shared-account collision and sizing spillovers?
economic_hypothesis: At least one frozen interaction should retain positive stressed uplift, positive stressed net, bounded proxy DD and majority direct changed-component attribution in both E4 and continuous June-July under every contract required by its declared role. Otherwise no formula seed survives.

why_now.source_clue: The closed 59-dimensional dual-portfolio formula lattice produced zero robust paired nominee, but recorded exactly two post-selection interaction points whose later economics were not opened.
why_now.not_an_optimization_rescue: The formula grid, neighbors, thresholds, modes and candidate search remain closed. This Lab unit accepts only the two exact point IDs and cannot search, rank, rescue or alter them.
why_now.distinct_decision: The fixed question is causal attribution and formula transfer. A passing point can create at most one exact Lab seed for a later separately owned Optimization campaign; a spillover-dominant or nontransferring point creates no seed.
why_now.review_context: The repository review correctly highlighted that portfolio uplift must not be mislabeled as pure signal alpha. This unit measures that distinction with component-level economics instead of changing the candidate.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: The entire 59-dimensional signal-formula surface and adjacent thresholds/windows/modes are frozen; no new entry rule is opened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: No external market or event state is involved and recent external-state units remain closed.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Clock, order, admission and session axes remain unchanged; any observed difference is attributable only through the fixed formula interactions and their shared-account propagation.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Stops, ARC, holds and exits remain exact baseline values; no held-position intervention is opened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Weights, risks, daily ladder, priority, occupancy and allocation remain exact in both portfolio contracts. Their interaction with changed signals is measured but cannot be retuned.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Selected because the new formula-lattice clue creates a bounded causal attribution question that can change whether one exact interaction has future Optimization authority.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Return to the Optimization whole map. Do not automatically open a neighbor, single-axis decomposition, alternate attribution threshold, component subgroup, period rescue or MT5 path.

selection_discovery_boundary.formal_process_use: integrity reproduction and changed-versus-unchanged component attribution only

formula_unseen_later_boundary.individual_months: reported diagnostics only and cannot rescue a failed primary gate
formula_unseen_later_boundary.important_caveat: The fixed replacement weights previously used E4 and June/July during portfolio selection. These periods are unseen by the two formula interactions only; they are not clean whole-portfolio OOS evidence.

frozen_attribution.baseline: Exact internal formula baseline under the same portfolio contract and interval
frozen_attribution.direct: Stressed uplift of the two components whose formulas changed
frozen_attribution.spillover: Stressed uplift of all unchanged components caused through shared capital ladder, admission, collision or sizing path
frozen_attribution.direct_absolute_share: sum(abs(changed-component stressed uplift)) / sum(abs(all component stressed uplift))
frozen_attribution.identity_gate: Direct plus unchanged stressed uplift must equal total stressed uplift within 1e-7 USD

fixed_transfer_gates.selection_reproduction: All four point-by-contract actual/stressed net, native-equivalent DD and closes reproduce within 1e-7 and exact count.
per_required_contract_and_primary_interv: stressed uplift versus exact formula baseline is strictly positive
stressed proxy DD is at most 20.0 percent for LIVE_CONTROL and 21.2 percent for FIXED_REPLACEMENT
changed components' summed stressed uplift is strictly positive
direct absolute attribution share is at least 0.50
component attribution identity error is at most 1e-7 USD

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_RETAIN_ONE_FIXED_FORMULA_INTERACTION_LAB_SEED when the first priority point passes every gate in both primary intervals for every required contract.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_LATER_FORMULA_ECONOMICS_OR_PORTFOLIO_SPILLOVER_NO_SEED when some later uplift exists but no point passes the complete direct-transfer contract.
fixed_verdict_rules.nonconfirmation: VALID_NO_TRANSFERABLE_DIRECT_FORMULA_INTERACTION_NO_SEED when neither point has positive required later transfer.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any input, identity, anchor, parser, serialization, design or implementation fault is CORRECTION_REQUIRED_NO_ECONOMIC_VERDICT and may be corrected without a numeric retry cap while this contract remains unchanged.

exclusions: any third point, neighbor, single-axis leg, threshold, mode, window, hold or ARC variant
alternate direct-share threshold, interval, epoch, month, contract, component, symbol, direction or cost subgroup
weight, risk, ladder, allocation, priority, admission, occupancy, stop, exit, sizing or capital change
bootstrap, resampling, significance rescue or a second economic aggregation
MQL, SET, compile, Strategy Tester, MT5, runtime, Live, Master or broker/account path
stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before opening any formula-unseen later interaction outcome.
Run the one frozen process only after every config, script and Lab-owned input pin passes.
Freeze the complete result and closure together; no runner-up or adjacent rescue follows.
After closure return immediately to the active Optimization whole-map comparison without pausing the user's Goal.
